blocks.text: Not too much to update on, but my goals for June are basically: apply to a ton of jobs, write to a few family members, save money, and do some Uber Eats on my bike since the weather is nice anyway.

I worked 43 hours this past week — I'm not supposed to go over 40, but I'm happy I'll get a nice paycheck. Today I brought a student to the orthopedist, and it was a really cool experience getting to sit in on a doctor's appointment that was in Spanish. I'm glad the student is healing well.
I'm going to apply to jobs at local universities, but also just try to be more ambitious about what I consider possible. Anything is possible!!!
